title: Solving the inverse graph model for conflict resolution using a hybrid metaheuristic algorithm
venue: European Journal of Operational Research Elsevier BV

title: A Novel Inverse Approach to the Graph Model for Conflict Resolution Using Genetic Algorithm
venue: 2020 IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics (SMC) IEEE

title: Bi-level genetic algorithm for Conflict Resolution in Simultaneous Games using an Inverse Graph Model
abstract: The standard forward Graph Model for Conflict Resolution (GMCR) predicts likely outcomes of a conflict from known decision-maker preferences, while the inverse GMCR seeks for preference structures leading to a specific equilibrium defined by the third-party. Inverse GMCR is NP-hard; thus, metaheuristics are essential especially in complex conflicts. This paper proposes a bi-level Genetic Algorithm (GA) for solving inverse GMCR in simultaneous games. There are three main contributions. First, a chromosome encoding is designed reflecting both local and global preference structures. Second, adaptive mutation is coupled by hybrid local search to balance exploration against exploitation. Third, the developed algorithm is proved to outperform traditional GAs in speed and convergence when applied to two abstract test-problems. In fact, additional comparative evaluations can better situate the work within the broader conflict resolution literature. The developed algorithm is beneficial to mediators and decision analysts in shaping outcomes of multifaceted conflicts.
